answer: Promotion out of probation demands 4 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. Because the jade record is per identity, the saffron audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, as every alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's cipher standing. The fee repeats 14 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
